q: Thane's chemical units burn more biomass than any other fuel: what does that do to their carbon figure?
title: Thane chemical cluster: biomass and CO2
short: Biomass briquettes give 34% of the Thane chemical cluster's 36,590 toe but none of its fossil CO2, which is reported separately. Grid power, only 23% of the energy, carries about 60% of the cluster's estimated 109,000 to 112,000 t fossil CO2. So kWh, not the boiler, drives most units' figures.
audience: Bulk drug, resin, dye and solvent units in the Thane chemical cluster

ul: More than 325 units; over 80% make bulk drugs, the rest solvent distillation, resins, dyes, pigments and cosmetic chemicals.
Light diesel, furnace oil and diesel: 10,081 kL, 8,889 toe.
Natural gas: 8 million scm, 7,012 toe, mainly in boilers.

p: The profile puts an API or pharmaceutical unit at 190.6 toe a year, of which 78.1 toe is electricity and 112.4 toe thermal. An other chemicals unit uses 150.2 toe, with only 21.6 toe electricity. Thermal energy is 73% of a unit's use, so the boiler fuel you choose sets your thermal CO2 and your power bill sets the rest.

ul: Briquettes and wood: report the CO2 as biogenic, outside Scope 1, with tonnes and supplier.
Methane and nitrous oxide from burning them do count in Scope 1, a small amount.
Gas, oil and coal: Scope 1 in full.
Keep briquette invoices by weight; a bill in rupees alone cannot be converted.

p: Thane is on BEE's first-phase ADEETIE list for chemicals, which supports efficient boilers, motors and other listed technologies with an interest subvention on a bank loan.

example.title: An API unit's own CO2 (estimate)
lines: Electricity: 78.1 toe = about 908 MWh x 0.675 = 613 t CO2
Thermal 112.4 toe on natural gas: 4,706 GJ x 56.1 kg = 264 t CO2, total about 877 t
Same thermal on briquettes: fossil total about 613 t, plus about 470 t biogenic reported separately
Cluster: gas 16,400 t, oil 26,700 to 29,900 t, power 65,745 t; biomass about 51,600 t biogenic
example.note: From the 2019-20 cluster profile with IPCC 2006 defaults (oil between diesel and furnace oil, biomass 100 kg CO2 per GJ) and the CEA FY 2025-26 grid factor.

senseible: Senseible reads briquette, gas and oil invoices and electricity bills into one record and keeps biomass CO2 on its own line, so your carbon number shows both.
